### 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you are proposing.

### 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]")

### 🚀 Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it enhances the user experience.

### 🛠️ Alternative Approaches
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup sketches, or screenshots about the feature request here.
